summary.text: One of the twelve suitors from Ithaca itself in Apollodorus' catalogue — attested only in the Epitome list of Penelope's wooers from the island.

story.text: Apollodorus names Aristratus among the twelve wooers of Penelope who came from Ithaca itself, listed with Antinous, Pronous, Liodes, Eurynomus, Amphimachus, Amphialus, Promachus, Amphimedon, Helenus, Dulicheus, and Ctesippus.
